name: Mistral AI Open Graph social card by mistral.ai
description: A 1200×630 social card split into two horizontal halves: a quiet white upper field carrying a two-line black grotesque headline flush left and the pixel-gradient wordmark anchored right, and a lower field built from flat horizontal colour bands stepping from orange through red-orange to deep crimson. A tiny pixel-art black cat sits on the left of the red band as a mascot easter egg, and faint bezier guide lines with anchor points are traced in the bands' right side as a subtle drafting motif. Everything is flat — no shadows, photos or gradients outside the logo — so the palette and the scale contrast between headline and bands carry the whole composition.
